verdict.summary_en: Chinese-language delivery note SN-261007-130 dated 2026-10-07 from Dongguan Precision Housings Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, for PO 4500318715. It lists one line: CMP-GAM-006 Steel Case Grand Heist 6, quantity 20.200 PCS in 20 packages, gross weight 300 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. It has a red supplier shipping seal, a handwritten receiver signature (Meyer K.) and a blue DC-HAM receiving stamp dated 10.11.2026. There are no corrections or strike-throughs.
red_flags: The quantity 20.200 PCS is ambiguous. I read it as 20,200 pieces, with the period as a thousands separator, because a fractional piece count makes no sense. It could be misread as 20.2. This works out to about 1,010 pieces per package across the 20 packages.
The note carries a remark that objections must be raised within three days. The receiving stamp is 10.11.2026, and the note is dated 2026-10-07.
The receiving stamp does not record a received quantity or any inspection result, so no count check is shown.
observations: The red circular supplier seal (Dongguan Precision Housings Co Ltd, 出货专用章, 'shipping special seal') overlaps the 单位 (unit) header and part of the 'PCS' cell. 'PCS' is still readable.
The signature next to the 收货签字 (receiver signature) label is handwritten and reads 'Meyer K.'.
The blue rectangular stamp reads 'RECEIVED 10.11.2026 / DC-HAM'. The date format is day.month.year.
The document has a barcode at the top right. The lower half of the page is blank.
